nuggets.text: Faizon Brandon scored five touchdowns in his debut against Furman, tying a Tennessee freshman record.
Mike Matthews caught touchdown passes of 55 and 57 yards from Faizon Brandon in the win over Furman.
The Vols piled up 638 yards against Furman: 329 on the ground and 309 through the air.
Josh Heupel was the 2000 Heisman Trophy runner-up and quarterbacked Oklahoma to that season's national title.
Josh Heupel grew up in Aberdeen, South Dakota, where his father was a head football coach at Northern State.
The Vol Navy: around 200 or more boats dock on the Tennessee River outside Neyland Stadium before games.
Smokey, the Vols' coonhound mascot, was chosen after a student poll in 1953.
The Vols' orange and white were picked by 1891 player Charles Moore, from the American daisy that grew on campus.
The Vols' checkerboard end zones, first used in 1964, copy the pattern atop the Ayres Hall clock tower.
The Vols won the last meeting with Georgia Tech 42-41 in double overtime in 2017, the teams' only game since 1987.
